setup_distributed_process_group: setup a PyTorch distributed process group for SLURM or local multi-GPU training with NCCL backend
cleanup_distributed: cleanup and destroy the initialized distributed process group and release GPU resources
all_reduce_tensors: perform an all-reduce operation on tensors across all ranks with optional averaging
all_gather_tensors: gather tensors from all ranks into a list using the all-gather collective operation
broadcast_tensor: broadcast a tensor from a source rank to all other ranks in the process group
